d:
Daya and the Gada family plan to visit Ahmedabad for Navratri. Wanting to stay and celebrate with his friends in Gokuldham, Tapu fakes an injury and illness, but Bapuji outsmarts him into confessing before finally agreeing to cancel the trip.
Are you ready for the challenge?
We bring to you the best videos from your favorite show Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah. So, get your daily dose of laughter with Jethalal, Taarak Mehta, Daya, Champaklal and their neighbors in Gokuldham Society.
